summary: Terry Pann, 60, of Nathrop — missing since July 22, 2020 in the Ice Mountain/Three Apostles area near Winfield; multi-day CCSAR-N search including drones failed to locate him; still unlocated as of Jul 28, 2020
location: Ice Mountain/Three Apostles area near Winfield
responding_agency: Chaffee County Search and Rescue North
notes: Still unlocated as of the Jul-28-2020 report; weather and extremely rugged/steep terrain hampered the search; CCSO asked anyone who hiked the area Jul 22-28 for information.
